_masks: [start_s, end_s, y_top, y_bottom]: hide the account usage notice under the prompt at the start
phases: The human sends one message: a goal and two examples.
Intake: herd status, no task yet. Sonnet designs here; a Haiku builder will write the code.
herd init starts the task on its own branch, herd/slugify. Risk: medium.
Criteria: Sonnet writes the checks and tests before any slugify code.
Second look: herd design-brief makes Sonnet challenge its own reading of the request.
Red first: attacks logged, then herd verify before any code. 0 of 5 pass: this failure is expected.
Build: a Haiku herd-builder subagent writes the code in the background.
Stop gate: Herd blocks Sonnet from finishing early, 3 times, then lets it wait.
The builder reports: all tests pass, herd verify 5 of 5.
Break it: Sonnet does not take the builder's word. It reads the code and probes it.
Found: some Unicode numbers are dropped, and invisible filler characters survive.
Two regression tests fail first, then the fix: 16 tests pass.
Every Unicode code point in 5 positions: 5,570,560 inputs, 0 failures.
Logs its notes and limits, commits, runs herd verify and herd done.
herd done: 5 of 5 criteria proven, with the commit and an evidence file.
Final report: what is proven and what is not, decisions and limits.
